// FAQ

Common questions.

What counts as an “approved page”?

A doc page someone reviewed and approved for publish. Drafts and rejected suggestions don’t count.

Is Mari really free for open source?

Yes. Any public repo runs on the Solo plan with limits lifted. Install the app and we’ll pick it up.

Do you train on our code or docs?

No. Mari runs on hosted models with zero retention. On Enterprise you can bring your own keys or run on-prem.

What happens if we cancel?

Your docs live in your repo. Mari just stops opening new PRs. No lock-in.

Can I localize on Solo?

Two source languages are included. For all 12 languages and Crowdin / Lokalise sync, you’ll need Team.

How does billing work for Team?

Per active reviewer seat, billed annually. Only reviewers are paid users; viewers are free and unlimited.
